topic: WALL RIDES BROKE THE FUEL CELL
quote: Like one year, I remember we were using the inner wall at Erwindale. We would back the car to the wall like so hard that we would like. I don't know if you ever like play Gran Turismo and you just like hold your finger down and use the berms. Yeah. Turn. We were like doing that in real life with the back of the car, Erwindale. And I was like just coming across the infield instead of lifting. I would just full blast and just go back into the long come down again. And I hit so hard we broke the fuel cell in the car. Oh, really? And the guys were like, all right, man, we've been just letting you do this for a while, but like no more of that. We're done. No more wall rides on the inner bank. And I remember being like, all right, fine. Yeah. There's not a lot of fun. And then Vaughn went out and broke the cell, did the same thing. Yeah. Because we were just using the wall to slow down.
why: Used the Irwindale inner wall like Gran Turismo, broke the fuel cell. Then Vaughn did too.
caption:
Chelsea DeNofa rode the Irwindale wall so hard he broke the fuel cell. Then Vaughn Gittin Jr. did the same.
